summary: Defines the application/vnd.pwg-multiplexed content type for objects made of several parts. Like multipart/related, it holds a sequence of chunks, each containing a MIME message or part of one, that together make up the whole object.

eli5.summary: Some things come in many pieces, like a set of parts. This label describes one package that carries several smaller messages in a line.

questions: how to package multiple mime messages in one object
